items.text: Suppose you are a Class Eight student. Write a formal email to the Upazila Nirbahi Officer requesting a voluntary medical team to support dengue patients.
items.explanation:
Sample email (addresses are examples):
To: recipient@example.com
From: student@example.com
Subject: a voluntary medical team for dengue patients

Dear Sir or Madam,

Dengue cases are causing concern in our community, and some families need guidance on where to seek care. Would your office consider coordinating a voluntary medical team with qualified health workers to help direct patients to appropriate services? We would also welcome information about preventing mosquito breeding.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Yours faithfully,
Amina
Class Eight
